sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Sir Lancelot, head of the one of the main branches of the [[Casterwill family]], hid his secrets inside the mausoleum in his hidden sanctuary. He filled it with paintings, books and treasures relating to his quest for the Holy Grail, along with the Amulet of [[Cavalier]]. To protect its secrets, he created a [[Ghost Trap]] with the form of his own image to guard it, along with numerous other traps and tests. {{source|Memory Lane}}

From their infiltration of the [[Huntik Foundation]], [[the Organization]] discovered the location of the Mausoleum and sent a team of [[Suits]] disguised as Foundation researchers to find out how to enter it. When [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Dante Vale]] arrived and discovered the entrance to hidden passage where the statue of [[Sir Bors]] was pointing his sword, a skirmish ensued and the Suits retreated while the pair entered the sanctuary. They managed to overcome Lancelot's numerous traps but didn't realize that [[Rassimov]] was helping them so that they could reach the treasure chamber. Upon arriving, Rassimov and his Suits and attacked and Rassimov obtained the Amulet of Cavalier. However, Cavalier refused to bond with such an evil Seeker and Rassimov used [[Darkvoid]] to destroy the room and everything in it, including Cavalier himself. Sophie and Dante then found Lok unconscious in another room where the inscription for the power [[Findshape]] was inscribed on the wall. {{Source|Memory Lane}}

sections.heading: Rooms and Obstacles
sections.wikitext:
*[[Ghost Trap]] - a ghostly version of Sir Lancelot, this would eliminate anyone who entered the hidden sanctuary
*[[Path of Trust]] - an army of ghostly knights that formed a walking path with their shields. Anyone who tried to fly over would be taken out by their swords.
*The Chamber of Purity and Sin - this room used multiple illusions to test a Seeker's purity. To pass this room, one has to overcome the several temptations to prove their worth, including greed, gluttony and vengeance on a helpless enemy. A row of crossbow bolts would fire upon anyone who failed. 
*Treasure chamber - this room contained all of Lancelot's treasures, including numerous [[Casterwill family]] books about the [[Amulet of Will]] and his Titan [[Cavalier]]

full_text:
The Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot is a large building containing Sir Lancelot's tomb and a hidden, underground sanctuary, where Sir Lancelot hid all of his treasures, including the Holy Grail, his Titan, Cavalier and books containing the Casterwill family secrets. 

== History ==
Sir Lancelot, head of the one of the main branches of the Casterwill family, hid his secrets inside the mausoleum in his hidden sanctuary. He filled it with paintings, books and treasures relating to his quest for the Holy Grail, along with the Amulet of Cavalier. To protect its secrets, he created a Ghost Trap with the form of his own image to guard it, along with numerous other traps and tests. [Memory Lane]

From their infiltration of the Huntik Foundation, the Organization discovered the location of the Mausoleum and sent a team of Suits disguised as Foundation researchers to find out how to enter it. When Lok Lambert and Dante Vale arrived and discovered the entrance to hidden passage where the statue of Sir Bors was pointing his sword, a skirmish ensued and the Suits retreated while the pair entered the sanctuary. They managed to overcome Lancelot's numerous traps but didn't realize that Rassimov was helping them so that they could reach the treasure chamber. Upon arriving, Rassimov and his Suits and attacked and Rassimov obtained the Amulet of Cavalier. However, Cavalier refused to bond with such an evil Seeker and Rassimov used Darkvoid to destroy the room and everything in it, including Cavalier himself. Sophie and Dante then found Lok unconscious in another room where the inscription for the power Findshape was inscribed on the wall. [Memory Lane]

== Rooms and Obstacles ==
*Ghost Trap - a ghostly version of Sir Lancelot, this would eliminate anyone who entered the hidden sanctuary
*Path of Trust - an army of ghostly knights that formed a walking path with their shields. Anyone who tried to fly over would be taken out by their swords.
*The Chamber of Purity and Sin - this room used multiple illusions to test a Seeker's purity. To pass this room, one has to overcome the several temptations to prove their worth, including greed, gluttony and vengeance on a helpless enemy. A row of crossbow bolts would fire upon anyone who failed. 
*Treasure chamber - this room contained all of Lancelot's treasures, including numerous Casterwill family books about the Amulet of Will and his Titan Cavalier
